question: Are there any upfront or hidden processing fees?
grounded_answer: We charge a one-time processing fee of 1.5% of your approved loan amount. This fee is deducted directly from the net loan disbursement, so there are no upfront out-of-pocket charges.

question: Can I pay off my loan early without penalty?
grounded_answer: Yes, absolutely. Our policy features a $0 prepayment penalty. You can make partial principal curtailments or settle the full loan balance at any time without fees.

question: What interest rate (APR) will I get on my loan?
grounded_answer: Our fixed Annual Percentage Rates (APR) depend on your credit score tier: Tier 1 (750+ score) is 6.49%, Tier 2 (700-749) is 8.99%, and Tier 3 (650-699) is 11.75%.

question: What is the minimum income needed to qualify?
grounded_answer: The minimum net monthly income requirement is $2,500 per month (or equivalent in local currency), supported by verifiable pay slips or bank statements.

question: What documents do I need to prepare?
grounded_answer: You need three documents: a valid government-issued photo ID (Passport, National ID, or Driver's License), proof of income (last 2 months pay slips or 3 months bank statements), and proof of residential address within the last 90 days.

question: What happens if I lose my job during the loan term?
grounded_answer: If you hold our Involuntary Unemployment Protection rider, the policy covers up to 6 monthly installments (up to $3,000 per month) following a 60-day initial waiting period.

question: Who receives the benefit if something happens to me?
grounded_answer: Under the Credit Life Insurance rider, the outstanding balance is paid in full directly to the lender, and an additional $10,000 direct family benefit is distributed to your named primary beneficiary.
